verdicts.reason: A shrinks the whole original into a small block in the middle of the leaderboard, leaving huge empty gray areas on both sides. The quote is tiny and the attribution can't be read, so this is a shrunk copy, not a resize. B rearranges the design left to right with the quote big and readable on the red panel and the skyline on the right. But the attribution is small and floats in the middle of the panel, the stray accent lines sit loose beside it, the white frame shows only as slivers, and the skyline is cut off into a cramped strip, so it needs polish before shipping.
